from fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog import fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog

# Test 1: Non-degenerate case (Ef << 0)
Ef_neg = -0.1  # eV
n_neg = fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog(Ef_neg)
print(f"Non-degenerate (Ef={Ef_neg} eV): n = {n_neg:.2e} cm^-3")

# Test 2: Degenerate case (Ef >> 0)
Ef_pos = 0.1  # eV
n_pos = fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog(Ef_pos)
print(f"Degenerate (Ef={Ef_pos} eV): n = {n_pos:.2e} cm^-3")

# Test 3: At Ef = 0
Ef_zero = 0.0
n_zero = fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog(Ef_zero)
print(f"Midgap (Ef={Ef_zero} eV): n = {n_zero:.2e} cm^-3")

# Test 4: Very large positive Ef
Ef_large = 1.0
n_large = fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog(Ef_large)
print(f"Highly degenerate (Ef={Ef_large} eV): n = {n_large:.2e} cm^-3")

# Test 5: Verify N_c calculation
# N_c for GaAs should be around 4.7e17 cm^-3
Ef = 0.0  # At η_F = 0, F_{1/2}(0) = 0.764
n_at_zero = fermi_dirac_integral_half_polylog(Ef)
print(f"\nAt Ef=0: n = {n_at_zero:.2e} cm^-3")
print(f"Expected N_c * F_{1/2}(0) ≈ N_c * 0.764")
</parameter>
</function>
